whatItDoes.text: A curated list of tools, resources, and knowledge for mass spectrometry-based proteomics - covering both bottom-up (peptide-centric) and top-down (proteoform-centric) approaches.

requirements.text: HUMOS - Interactive Orbitrap eLearning app that models peptide-mixture spectra so learners can explore resolution, duty cycle, ion accumulation, dynamic range, and BoxCar (self-host; SDU live site may block bots) (paper). [GUI] 📦

MassDash - Web/Python dashboard for interactive DIA chromatogram and ion-mobility visualization across OpenSWATH, DIA-NN, and dreamDIA results (v0.1.1; demo may redirect to Streamlit login) (paper). [DIA] [GUI] [API] 📦
OmicLearn - Browser Streamlit app for transparent ML biomarker discovery from proteomics/omics matrices (classifiers, feature importance; v1.4; Streamlit demo may require login) (paper). [GUI]

SLiMSuite - Edwards-lab open-source SLiM discovery/analysis toolkit (SLiMFinder etc.; v1.12.0, 2024; blog) complementary to ELM/SLiMSuite; UNSW web servers out of action as of 2025—use GitHub/self-host (method; server). [CLI]
